$comment: Per-component versions. The plugin version tells someone the PLUGIN is stale; this tells them
which of the components THEY used actually changed, which is the only thing that makes them
act. Bump a component's version in the same commit that changes its spec — scripts/check-drift.sh
reads this file and a build's stamp, and reports the intersection.
version = the plugin version in which that component's spec last changed.
breaking = true when a build using it will render WRONG until updated, as opposed to merely
missing an improvement. Drift on a breaking change is reported as MUST, everything else as MAY.
